gaps: Does the forge.cmd python3 probe break the WIN-1 cross-platform text assertions?
Is init/adopt/upgrade remediation safe re: write_manifest ordering and the upgrade.py repository-escape tripwire?
Can the bootstrap re-exec loop infinitely?
resolutions: The two text assertions (version-gate string count, where-index chain) update in the same change; they run on every platform, pinned by the existing test.
Remediation runs at the TAILS after write_manifest (mutates no vendored files); upgrade.py edits are tail-only — a copy-path change would trip the escalation tripwire and is out of scope.
A loop-guard env var set before the single re-exec prevents infinite bootstrap; second entry with the guard set and still no python exits 2 with the manual fix.
